title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Tropical Mango Banana 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Doozy Seriously Tropical Nic Salt Mango Banana combines the sweet, refreshing taste of sun-ripened mangoes and creamy bananas, delivering a smooth and satisfying vape. Doozy Vape Co., based in the UK, are renowned for creating high-quality e-liquids in a staggering variety of exciting flavour profiles you won’t find anywhere else. Their Seriously Tropical Nic Salt collection brings together some of the most vibrant and tropical exotic fruit blends for a sweet, satisfying and sunny vaping experience.
